name: Financial Condition Communications to Rating Agencies
description: Ongoing communication with bond rating agencies about the District's financial condition, with full disclosure in every financial report and official statement provided to them and to investors.
recipient: Bond rating agencies, bond service providers and investors
quote: The district will also maintain communication with bond rating agencies about its financial condition and will follow a policy of full disclosure in every financial report and official statement provided to bond rating agencies, to legal and professional service providers for bond issues, and to investors.
